files.README.md:
# shop-api

REST API generated by [Model2API](https://raulesteveza.github.io/tools/Model2API/) with Spring Boot. It is a starting point: review it before using it in production.

## Run it

Requires Java 21 and Maven 3.9 or later.

```bash
mvn spring-boot:run
```

Set the variables of `.env.example` in your environment first. The API listens on http://localhost:8080; the interactive documentation is at http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html, and the contract in `openapi.yaml`.

## Test it

```bash
mvn test
```

The tests use an in-memory H2 database, or the one in `TEST_DATABASE_URL` (with `TEST_DATABASE_USER` and `TEST_DATABASE_PASSWORD`).

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | What it does | Success | Access |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/customers` | List customers | 200 | public |
| `GET` | `/customers/{id}` | Get a customer | 200 | public |
| `POST` | `/customers` | Create a customer | 201 | public |
| `PUT` | `/customers/{id}` | Replace a customer | 200 | public |
| `PATCH` | `/customers/{id}` | Update part of a customer | 200 | public |
| `DELETE` | `/customers/{id}` | Delete a customer | 204 | public |
| `GET` | `/products` | List products | 200 | public |
| `GET` | `/products/{id}` | Get a product | 200 | public |
| `POST` | `/products` | Create a product | 201 | public |
| `PUT` | `/products/{id}` | Replace a product | 200 | public |
| `PATCH` | `/products/{id}` | Update part of a product | 200 | public |
| `DELETE` | `/products/{id}` | Delete a product | 204 | public |
| `GET` | `/orders` | List orders | 200 | public |
| `GET` | `/orders/{id}` | Get an order | 200 | public |
| `POST` | `/orders` | Create an order | 201 | public |
| `PUT` | `/orders/{id}` | Replace an order | 200 | public |
| `PATCH` | `/orders/{id}` | Update part of an order | 200 | public |
| `DELETE` | `/orders/{id}` | Delete an order | 204 | public |

Errors always have the same body: `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": [...]}}`. Invalid requests answer 400.

## Storage

JPA with Hibernate on mysql. Hibernate creates missing tables while you develop (`spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=update`); for a real database, use migrations (Model2DB writes them). Embedded objects and lists are stored as JSON columns, and references as key columns.

## Authentication

Every endpoint is public.

## Structure

```text
src/main/java/com/example/api/
  common/               errors, lists and request bodies
  shared/               enums and embedded objects
  <resource>/           model, request and response, repository, service and controller of one resource
src/test/java/          one test class per resource
openapi.yaml            the contract of the API
```

## Left to you

- Nothing marked: review the generated code before using it.

spring.application.name=shop-api
server.port=${PORT:8080}

# Unknown fields in a request body are an error, as openapi.yaml describes
spring.jackson.deserialization.fail-on-unknown-properties=true

# Database connection (environment variables DATABASE_URL, DATABASE_USER, DATABASE_PASSWORD)
spring.datasource.url=${DATABASE_URL:jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/api}
spring.datasource.username=${DATABASE_USER:api}
spring.datasource.password=${DATABASE_PASSWORD:}
# Creates missing tables while you develop; use migrations for a real database (Model2DB writes them)
spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=update
spring.jpa.open-in-view=false
# Date-times are stored in UTC, so they read back the same on any server
spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.timezone.default_storage=NORMALIZE_UTC
# Column names that are reserved words in some database (MySQL: "lines", "order"…) are quoted
spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.auto_quote_keyword=true

# Unknown fields in a request body are an error, as openapi.yaml describes
spring.jackson.deserialization.fail-on-unknown-properties=true

# An in-memory H2 database, or the database in TEST_DATABASE_URL
spring.datasource.url=${TEST_DATABASE_URL:jdbc:h2:mem:test;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1}
spring.datasource.username=${TEST_DATABASE_USER:sa}
spring.datasource.password=${TEST_DATABASE_PASSWORD:}
spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=create-drop
spring.jpa.open-in-view=false
spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.timezone.default_storage=NORMALIZE_UTC
# Column names that are reserved words in some database (MySQL: "lines", "order"…) are quoted
spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.auto_quote_keyword=true
